scope: The standing exterior of the 1972 Al Alam ceremonial palace in Old Muscat, including its central square pavilion with flared entrance columns and the long wings attached to that building. Excludes interior rooms, the harbor forts and independently mapped government and mosque buildings.

review.notes: The published Qualla images were screened first. The only public-domain-labelled exterior matches the exact 2007 original file later transferred to Commons. The written law protects architecture and provides no general architectural-photograph exception, so the photograph was excluded. No supplemental photographs, drawings or image-derived textures were used.
